Q6097.reason: In most states a grant to someone 'and the heirs of his body' creates a fee simple absolute, so the cousin took the whole estate and the later deed gave the niece nothing.

Q5137.reason: The examining doctor may give a medical opinion from x-rays he personally read; FRE 703 does not require those films to be in evidence first, and the best-evidence rule does not bar that opinion.

Q5526.reason: Only the nighttime break-in of the occupied hotel room has common-law breaking, entry, a dwelling, nighttime, and intent to commit a felony inside; each other choice lacks at least one element.
